name: order_blood_smear
description: Orders a peripheral blood smear examination by a hematologist or pathologist. Evaluates red cell morphology, white cell differential, and platelet appearance. Essential for identifying schistocytes, sickle cells, target cells, blasts, and other morphological abnormalities.

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering blood smear

specific_findings_suspected.description: Specific findings to look for (e.g., schistocytes, blasts, sickle cells, malarial parasites)

when_to_use: Abnormal CBC results (abnormal cell counts or indices)
Leukemia or lymphoma workup (blasts, atypical cells)

examples.query: Get peripheral smear looking for schistocytes

args.clinical_indication: thrombocytopenia and anemia concerning for TTP
